newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Bachaquero oil sale cancelled again.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Bachaquero oil sale cancelled again.

text.p: Venezuelan state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) canceled for the second time Friday the scheduled auction of the Bachaquero oil field after no bids were received, a PDVSA spokesman said.

Operating rights were to be sold as part of Venezuela's third oil contracts auction round which has attracted some $2 billion in bids over the past five days. The Bachaquero field was first offered Wednesday.
A re-auction of the Cretacico oil field was similarly canceled earlier Friday after no bidders came forward.
The re-auction completed the week's round of sales that attracted 131 oil companies from around the world to bid for operating contracts to 20 oil blocks.
